description.text:
A top-four deck of the Masters Division at the 2014 World Championships, built to exploit each opponent's Weakness with one of five attackers: Mega Kangaskhan-EX, Mewtwo-EX, Xerneas-EX, Keldeo-EX or Xerneas. Aromatisse's Ability moves Fairy Energy off a Pokémon before Max Potion heals it, then puts the Energy back. The 2014 World Championships were held at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center in Washington, D.C., from 15 to 17 August 2014.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2014 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
